name: Hair Trigger
desc: The first two ambers drop at random. Launch windows halved.
hint: Ignore the first ambers. Green always comes half a second after the THIRD.

name: Oil Slick
desc: Oil on your lane. Shifting with the rear wheels on oil is a MISS and spins.
hint: Watch the black patches and the OIL marks on your tach. Shift before or after them.

name: Gale Force
desc: Gusts sweep the strip: they slow you down and squeeze the shift window.
hint: The gust meter warns you. Shift just before a gust hits, or wait it out.

name: Drifting Window
desc: The shift window jumps to a new spot every gear. Late shifts are a MISS.
hint: Don't shift on rhythm. Find the green band again after every shift.

name: Decoy Tree
desc: A fake flash fires before green. Jumping on it is a false start.
hint: The decoy is a lime flicker. Real green stays lit, half a second after the third amber.

name: Short Shift
desc: Shift windows sit far below redline. Late shifts are a MISS.
hint: Shift way earlier than feels right: watch for the green band low on the tach.

name: Mirror Tach
hint: The needle sweeps LEFT now. Shift when it reaches the green band on the left.

name: Blackout
desc: Your tach cuts out for stretches of the race.
hint: It flickers before it dies. Listen to the engine and shift by ear.

name: Slick Track
hint: Grip is down: a perfect launch matters more than ever. Tires help.

name: Blind Tach
desc: Shift windows are HIDDEN, and 15% narrower.
hint: The window is where it always is, just under redline. Shift by needle and engine note.

name: Sudden Death
desc: Any MISS (launch, shift or false start) loses the race on the spot.
hint: A GOOD is safe. Don't gamble on Perfects: no false starts, no limiter.

name: Redline Only
desc: Shift windows halved and your rightmost passive is disabled.
hint: Tiny window right under redline. Move your weakest passive to the right.

name: The Squeeze
desc: The shift window shrinks every gear: 3rd-to-4th is a sliver.
hint: Your last shift is the hardest. Settle in: it's 45% of normal width.
